g.title: spend-control-layers
g.text: Spend control layers: what checks an action before capital moves
The LLM or strategy output has no authority. The chain does not trust the off-chain engine to be correct.
Implemented, off or not yet run on testnet
Designed, not built or not deployed

g.title: prop
g.text: Strategy output: a trade intent or an information request
A proposal is never an authorization

g.title: l2
g.text: Signed, hash-chained policy; unverified means no action
Allowlist, recipient of every transfer or approve, pair
Plan hash equals the approved hash
Per-action cap on the sum of all calls in the plan
Session daily cap over the same rolling window as the chain
Information caps per tick and per day

g.title: l1v
g.text: Layer 1a: spend policy check, validation phase
Target and selector on the allowlist, never the policy
Recipient decoded only on transfer and approve of the
settlement asset or a traded asset; must be an allowed contract
Zero native value; per-tx cap on the sum of a batch

g.title: l1e
g.text: Layer 1b: spend policy record, execution phase
Rolling daily cap: 25 hourly buckets, never under-counts
Needs the clock, which ERC-7562 forbids in validation

g.title: done
g.text: Settlement asset moves only to an allowlisted contract
within the per-transaction and daily caps

g.title: x402
g.text: Separate x402 key, ERC-1271 path only
Payee list, 0.05 USDC each, 300 s, 4 per hour
At most 26 x 4 x 0.05 = 5.20 USDC per 24 h
Counted by the token nonce, not the daily cap

g.title: l3
g.text: Checked every evaluation: capital at risk, and
reallocation volume. A trip halts every tick across
restarts until a human clears it; built, tested offline
